data.name: Kanishk
data.gender_notes: Kanishk is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kanishk is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu God Kshana, which represents the concept of time and the passing of time. The name Kanishk signifies the power to control and manipulate time, and is believed to bestow upon the bearer the wisdom to make the most of every moment. The name Kanishk carries the meaning “God of Time and Destiny” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Kanishk usually hope their child will grow to embody god of time and destiny and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine power of time and destiny, and is believed to bring blessings of wisdom, intelligence, and the ability to overcome challenges.
data.etymology: Kanishk belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Time and Destiny.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kanishk total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kanishk holds great significance in Hindu culture as it is directly linked with the divine God Kshana, who is believed to be the ruler of time. In Hindu mythology, the God Kshana is depicted as a being who can pause, accelerate or even reverse the flow of time. A person named Kanishk is therefore believed to possess an unusual connection with time and an ability to seize each moment with utmost importance.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kanishk holds great symbolism for the Hindu philosophy of living in the present moment. It is believed that by acknowledging the power of the divine God Kshana and embracing one's own name, a person named Kanishk is blessed with an awareness to make every moment count, to seek wisdom and growth in each situation, and to recognize the interconnectedness of all things. Thus, the name Kanishk serves as a constant reminder to appreciate the present moment and strive for spiritual growth in every aspect of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kanishk: Radiant, wise and just ruler. Symbolizes inner light guiding righteous actions.

vedic_reference.note: Kanishk is a Vedic name derived from the Sanskrit words 'kana' and 'ishtha'. It is mentioned in various Hindu texts as a name of a king or a ruler.

historical_references.reference: The great Emperor Kanishka ruled the Kushana Empire from 128 to 150 AD. He was a patron of Buddhism and is best known for his extensive rock edicts and coins that spread the word of Buddhism far and wide.
historical_references.context: Patron of Buddhism, left extensive rock edicts and coins

historical_references.reference: Kanishka is also known for his military conquests that expanded the Kushana Empire to include parts of present-day Afghanistan, Pakistan, and India. He is considered one of the greatest pioneers of ancient Indian history and tradition.
historical_references.context: Expanded Kushana Empire through military conquests

modern_usage.modern_context: In the modern context, the name 'Kanishk' is often associated with individuals who are prominent in the fields of technology, entrepreneurship, and innovation. This is likely due to the historical significance of the name as belonging to Emperor Kanishka, who is known for his patronage of Buddhism and the arts. However, in the contemporary world, the name 'Kanishk' has taken on a new meaning, representing individuals who are trailblazers in their respective industries and are making a significant impact on society through their work. For instance, you may find 'Kanishk' as a name on LinkedIn profiles of tech entrepreneurs, Quora profiles of thought leaders in innovation, and Medium articles by writers exploring the latest technology trends. The name has become a symbol of progress and creativity, inspiring those who bear it to push boundaries and strive for excellence.
